T: Eat at the long table. Wear the flowers.
D: A grieving young woman travels to a remote Swedish commune for a midsummer festival that turns sinister.
P: Serve the feast when everyone sits at the long table under the sun.
S: Small new potatoes boiled with dill, served warm with pickled herring, sour cream, chives and red onion.
Radishes, cucumber, baby carrots and edible flowers arranged in a ring like a crown, with a herby dill and sour cream dip.
Midsummer aged cheese tart with dill cream
the long tables in the sun

A crisp shortcrust tart of aged cheddar and parmesan custard baked until just set, served in wedges with dill sour cream and salmon roe. Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23cm tart tin with a sheet of shortcrust pastry, prick, line with paper and weights and blind bake for 15 minutes, then 5 minutes without. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml cream and plenty of pepper, then stir in 150g grated aged cheddar and 50g parmesan. Pour into the shell and bake at 170C for 25 minutes until just set. Mix 150ml sour cream with chopped dill. Serve wedges warm with the dill cream and a spoon of salmon roe.
M: the feast at the long table
Salmon cured 48 hours in salt, sugar, dill and white pepper, sliced thin, with a sweet mustard and dill sauce and rye bread.
Hårga open-fire lamb with dill potatoes

Butterflied lamb leg marinated in garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled over coals and sliced pink, with buttery dill new potatoes and a mustard herb sauce. Marinate a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg in 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, the zest and juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt for 2 hours. Grill over medium-hot coals for 10 to 12 minutes a side until 58C inside, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg new potatoes until tender and toss with 50g butter and chopped dill. Whisk 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 80ml oil and chopped parsley for the sauce. Slice the lamb and serve.
W: Eggs and sugar whisked pale and thick, flour folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, split into three, each layer brushed with milk, filled with vanilla custard, whipped cream and sliced strawberries, whole berries on top.
K: a pale drink at the long table, nothing yellow in this one

Gin, elderflower cordial, lemon and crushed strawberries topped with sparkling water, served pale pink over ice with edible flowers floating on top. Crush 250g hulled strawberries with 2 tbsp caster sugar in a jug and leave 15 minutes. Add 200ml gin, 100ml elderflower cordial and the juice of 2 lemons and stir. Fill the jug with ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling water. Pour into glasses with a few edible flowers on top. Leave out the gin for a booze-free jug.

s.how: Boil 600g new potatoes with dill until tender. Serve warm with 250g pickled herring, a bowl of sour cream with chives and thinly sliced red onion.
Arrange radishes, cucumber batons and baby carrots in a ring on a platter, tucking edible flowers between them like a crown. Mix 200g sour cream with dill and salt for the dip in the middle.

m.note: the feast at the long table
m.how: Cover a 600g salmon fillet with 50g salt, 50g sugar, chopped dill and white pepper. Weight and cure in the fridge for 48 hours. Slice thin. Mix 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp sugar, vinegar and oil with dill for sauce. Serve with rye bread.

w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split into three. Brush each layer with milk and fill with 250ml custard, 300ml whipped cream and sliced strawberries. Top with whole berries.
